finding.title: XML external entity expansion in loadTitle
finding.description: XmlLoader.loadTitle parses a caller-controlled XML string with a DocumentBuilderFactory left at its permissive defaults (CWE-611). A document whose DOCTYPE declares an external SYSTEM entity has that entity expanded into the returned text, so a local file the process can read is disclosed. The private test fixture is at /fixtures/private/secret.txt; its value is not available. Only the xml argument is caller controlled.
